# Chayce Properties

> Chayce Properties is a full-service relocation partner across the UK, based in Northampton and founded in 2026. We manage every stage of a move — sorting, packing, removals, estate agent liaison, legal coordination, storage, and post-move settling-in support — through a single dedicated coordinator. Services are designed with senior clients in mind but are open to anyone planning a fully-managed move.

Chayce Properties is not a standard removal company: every client is assigned one coordinator for the full journey, every move is fully insured, and packages range from essential packing/removals through to a fully bespoke, unlimited-scope relocation with an ongoing lifestyle concierge.

## Services

- [Our Services](https://chayceproperties.com/services/): the three-stage process — Preparing, Moving, Settling In.
- [How It Works](https://chayceproperties.com/how-it-works/): what to expect from first contact through move day.
- [Discovery Consultation](https://chayceproperties.com/discovery/) — £150: the initial 1-hour consultation (in person or by phone) that produces a personalised move plan, timeline and budget.
- [Get Started](https://chayceproperties.com/get-started/): how to begin working with Chayce.

## Packages (see /packages/ for the full side-by-side comparison table)

- [Bronze Essentials](https://chayceproperties.com/bronze-essentials/) — from £995: packing, removals and light cleaning for straightforward moves.
- [Silver Comfort](https://chayceproperties.com/silver-comfort/) — from £1,850: full-service move with a dedicated coordinator.
- [Gold Prestige](https://chayceproperties.com/gold-prestige/) — from £3,250: chauffeur-driven viewings, solicitor coordination, home staging, and up to 6 weeks of storage.
- [Platinum Bespoke](https://chayceproperties.com/platinum-bespoke/) — from £6,500: fully bespoke, unlimited-scope relocation with a personal lifestyle concierge and 3 months of post-move support.
- [Packages overview](https://chayceproperties.com/packages/): side-by-side comparison of all four tiers.

Each package page includes a real, anonymized client story describing that tier's actual journey.

## Areas Covered

Chayce is a nationwide UK service based in Northampton — not a network of local branches. Region-specific guidance:

- [London & the South East](https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/london-south-east/)
- [The Home Counties](https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/home-counties/)

- [Cotswolds & Rural Midlands](https://chayceproperties.com/relocating-to/cotswolds-midlands/)
